original_description: Digitize PNG, JPG, SVG, and WebP artwork into embroidery designs, or convert existing embroidery files between machine formats such as PES, DST, JEF, VP3, EXP, and more. Upload a file to create a private stitch preview, then review thread-rendered stitches, dimensions, thread colours, warnings, and production metrics in ChatGPT.
summary_ja: 画像を刺繍データ化したり刺繍ミシン用の形式を変換したりして、縫い目や寸法を確認する。
limitations: 実動作・変換品質・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
